futureLayerResponsibilities: Preserve the complete observed apparatus and one narrow screen opening.

decisions.photographContingency: If a later separately authorized brief requires genuine ripple-photo semantic artwork, route that changed requirement to hybrid/generated and PAID_ART_HOLD; never fake a photograph with deterministic freeforms.
